Run ERun backend API over HTTP

Usage:
  erun api [TENANT] [ENVIRONMENT] [flags]

Examples:
  erun api --host <LOOPBACK> --port 17033
  erun api tenant-a dev

Flags:
      --aws-identity-store-id string       AWS IAM Identity Center identity store ID used to resolve usernames from STS tokens
      --aws-identity-store-region string   AWS region for Identity Store username lookup
      --database-url string                Backend PostgreSQL database URL; defaults to ERUN_DATABASE_URL
      --dry-run                            Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
  -h, --help                               help for api
      --host string                        Host interface to bind the backend API HTTP server to (default "<LOOPBACK>")
      --oidc-allowed-issuers string        Comma-separated OIDC issuer allow-list
      --port int                           Port to bind the backend API HTTP server to (default 17033)

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.
